name: mazda_nd_hs
title: CAN data collection: MX-5 ND (HS-CAN only)

hs.label: HS-CAN 500 kbit/s
hs.point: OBD-II: pin 6 (CAN_H), pin 14 (CAN_L) — main chassis bus of MX-5 ND

warnings: Immobilizer MX-5 ND — without bypass/emulation, the engine will not start (critical).
EPS — in the swap RE, EPS was not working: need to emulate the PCM signal or replace with hydraulic (critical).
ABS/DSC — if the PCM signal is absent, they may be disabled: need to emulate torque (critical).
Start/Stop Unit MX-5 ND — will not start without emulating the stock PCM: this is an independent authentication loop.
HS-only scenario: MS-CAN (BCM pins 2F/2H, HVAC/body) is NOT recorded here — MS-only signals are marked in notes for a separate MS-CAN scenario.

stages.title: Equipment preparation and basic configuration (HS-CAN)
checklist: Connect HS-CAN: OBD-II pin 6 (CAN_H), pin 14 (CAN_L) -> /dev/ttyUSB0
HS-CAN = 500 kbit/s (std, 11-bit ID); single adapter, single log channel
Rules: 5s quiet -> action 5-15s -> 5s after; each test x3; pause >=10s
ABS/DSC with speed — closed lot only
All PCM-facing signals are on HS-CAN — record into /dev/ttyUSB0 in every test

stages.title: Baseline: passive listening of power states
stages.warn: Record background traffic and identify the list of active CAN IDs for each state. These logs are the reference for all later diffs (stages 12-13).

tests.title: Ignition off, all blocks de-energized
tests.do: Wait; control signals (if any)

tests.title: Ignition on, engine not started
tests.do: Immobilizer handshake, dashboard self-test, EPS, ABS

tests.title: Engine idling (warm)
tests.do: PCM: RPM, temperature, fuel, load; cluster / OBD traffic

tests.title: Engine stopped, ignition off
tests.do: Record the shutdown sequence and completion signals

stages.title: Start, immobilizer and Start/Stop (i-stop)
stages.warn: ND-specific: the start loop includes immobilizer exchange (PCM <-> Start/Stop Unit) and i-stop shutdown/restart cycles. Record the handshakes here — the emulation target list begins with them.

tests.title: Engine start (crank + run)
tests.do: Brake pressed, press start button: crank until the engine catches, then let go (idle). Start from neutral.

tests.title: Dry crank (no start)
tests.do: Crank 2-3 s and release; the engine must not start. Log the PCM request that came before/during the crank (immobilizer sync, start command).
tests.warn: If the immobilizer is not synced yet, the crank will not fire — record the 'waiting' request.

tests.title: Immobilizer handshake (key on -> wait -> off)
tests.do: Ignition on, wait 5 s, then off. Capture the PCM <-> Start/Stop <-> cluster pair (ID to be confirmed by diff with 1.1.2).

tests.title: i-stop: activate (neutral, standing)
tests.do: Neutral, brake, let go when allowed — i-stop shuts the engine down. Log A/F: battery, PCM shutdown sequence, cluster message.

tests.title: i-stop: return from shutdown
tests.do: From i-stop: brake press (or D + brake, per the car logic) — engine restarts. Log the start-from-i-stop sequence.

tests.title: i-stop: OFF button
tests.do: Press the i-stop disable button, confirm the state change on the cluster; back to ON after the record.

stages.title: Engine: RPM and throttle (stand / wheels off)
stages.warn: Warm engine. Neutral, on stand or wheels off the ground. All actions smooth unless stated otherwise.

tests.title: Smooth press 0->25%
tests.do: Smoothly bring the accelerator pedal up to 25%

tests.title: Hold 25%
tests.do: Hold 25%

tests.title: Smooth press 25->50%
tests.do: Smoothly bring it up to 50%

tests.title: Hold 50%
tests.do: Hold 50%

tests.title: Sharp press 0->100%
tests.do: Snap the pedal to the floor

tests.title: Smooth release 100->0%
tests.do: Smoothly release the pedal

tests.title: Idle (warmed up)
tests.do: Record the average value

tests.title: Smooth ramp-up to 2000 rpm
tests.do: Smoothly raise to 2000 rpm and hold

tests.title: Smooth ramp-up to 3000 rpm
tests.do: Smoothly raise to 3000 rpm and hold

tests.title: Smooth ramp-up to 5000 rpm
tests.do: Smoothly raise to 5000 rpm and hold

tests.title: Sharp drop to idle
tests.do: Release the pedal — drop back to idle

tests.title: Blip (if safe)
tests.do: Brief throttle blip, warmed-up engine only

stages.title: Transmission (MT): gear position signals
stages.warn: The swap PCM reads gear position (0x165). Record every shift command and the reverse light; gear IDs are 'confirm' right now.

tests.title: Reverse: short back + return to N
tests.do: Short R for a few meters, then N; confirm the reverse light and the PCM-visible R state.

stages.title: Braking (static, stand)
stages.warn: Closed lot / stand. Pedal and handbrake states; ABS pulsing engages only from speed — see stage 6.

tests.title: Handbrake up
tests.note: ND handbrake signal: to be confirmed (likely in cluster/DSC message; RX-8 equivalent was 0x212 byte4 mask 0x40).

tests.title: Handbrake down
tests.note: ND handbrake signal: to be confirmed.

tests.title: DSC/TCS off (button)
tests.note: DSC/TCS state flags: to be confirmed (cluster message).

tests.title: DSC/TCS on (button, back to default)
tests.note: Pair with 5.1.6: record the on/off state-change delta.

tests.title: Brake pedal to the floor (stand)
tests.do: Press the pedal fully from idle; log the ABS/DSC ECU reactions (wheel-speed watchdog, brake requests).
tests.note: Real ABS pulsing is captured from speed in 6.1.3.

stages.title: Driving (closed lot): motion, DSC/ABS, BA, wheel spin
stages.warn: Closed lot only. Two people: driver + spotter. Speed limit 50 km/h. Do not continue on public roads!

tests.title: 0 -> 30 km/h (1st -> 2nd, smooth)
tests.do: Smooth launch, upshift, decelerate back to 0.
tests.note: First capture of the vehicle-speed field (0x202 bytes 2-3) in motion.

tests.title: Steady cruise 30-50 km/h
tests.do: Constant speed, gentle corrections; record the long-duration traffic (can-throttle, DSC, cluster).

tests.title: ABS/DSC engagement from speed (30 -> stop, firm pressure)
tests.do: From ~30 km/h: firm, constant brake pressure until ABS pulses. Catch the DSC ECU messages (wheel speeds, modulation bursts).
tests.note: DSC ECU ID: to be confirmed — the swap emulator must produce/consume it.

tests.title: BA / hill-start assist
tests.do: On a 5-10 degree slope: stop, N -> D, release the brake — BA holds the car for a couple of seconds.
tests.note: BA state visible to the PCM? To be confirmed (DSC message).

tests.title: Wheel spin / DSC traction (1st gear, sharp throttle)
tests.do: 1st gear, sharp throttle: front wheels spin, DSC cuts. Record the wheel-speed and intervention messages.
tests.note: Wheel speeds: the swap ABS radar equivalent — must be mapped before the DSC is disabled.

tests.title: EPS off (wheel center, button)
tests.do: With the steering wheel centered, press the DSC/EPS-related button: EPS off/on transitions; return the wheel and restore EPS.
tests.warn: ND-specific: in the swap RE, EPS did not work without the PCM signal — capture the EPS state flag and which ECU owns it.

stages.title: Body electronics and comfort (HS side)
stages.warn: ND: most body signals live on MS-CAN (BCM pins 2F/2H) — outside this scenario. Here we record the HS side: 0x09A lighting state and everything that changes vs the baseline by state comparison. MS-only signals are flagged for the separate MS-CAN scenario.

tests.title: Turn signals (left): on/off
tests.note: Lever state is MS-side; confirm any HS relay by diff with the baseline.

tests.title: Windshield wipers (intermittent)
tests.note: MS-side; any HS-visible change (e.g. cluster status) is to be confirmed.

tests.title: Driver door: open/close
tests.note: Door state (MS-side) may be mirrored to the cluster on HS - to be confirmed.

stages.title: HVAC (HS side: engine reaction only)
stages.warn: The HVAC itself is on MS-CAN (125 kbit/s) and is NOT covered by this scenario. Here we only record the HS-side consequence: A/C load on the engine (RPM / throttle compensation / A-F status if visible on HS), the rear-defrost and seat-heater current draw. A full HVAC mapping needs a separate MS-CAN scenario.

tests.title: A/C on/off (watch engine compensation)
tests.note: Look for A/F or HVAC status mirrored to HS (cluster / PCM message) — to be confirmed.

tests.title: Rear-window defrost on/off
tests.note: Watch the battery/current response on HS (charging/battery messages, ID to be confirmed).

stages.title: Instrument panel and indicators (HS side)
stages.warn: MX-5 ND: indicator IDs to be confirmed (likely 0x720 cluster diagnostics). Establish which cluster message carries each lamp by comparing baseline (stage 1) with the lamp-on state.

tests.title: Monitor the fuel level (at various levels)
tests.do: Filling steps: log the gauge response at several fuel levels (or by fuel trim states).

tests.title: Monitor the engine temperature needle (during warm-up)
tests.note: ND coolant-temp ID: to be confirmed (RX-8 equivalent was 0x420 byte 0, value-40).

stages.title: Diagnostics: OBD / UOID (manual sends)
stages.warn: UOID traffic goes through the HS gateway; the ND gateway request/response IDs are to be confirmed. Send manually with `canductor link /dev/ttyUSB0 --send <id> <data>` while recording.
checklist: 1) Even a wrong request is useful: the gateway answer (or silence) marks the diagnostic path.
2) Classic Mazda UOID (11-bit): request 0x7DF/0x701 channel, answer on 0x7E8/0x7EC — confirm for ND.
3) Keep a DTC snapshot (11.1.2) BEFORE the clear (11.1.4).
4) Reset/clear DTCs only at the very end of the whole campaign.

tests.title: UOID Mode 01 41/42: ECU status
tests.do: Send the ECU-status request after ignition on (PCM present, engine off); log the gateway response.

tests.title: UOID Mode 03: read DTC
tests.do: Read the stored DTCs (all modules the gateway forwards); this is the reference DTC snapshot.

tests.title: UOID Mode 01: read-only PIDs (fuel trim etc.)
tests.do: Read-only PIDs (e.g. 0C fuel trim, 0A control group, 0C runner) at idle: verifies the gateway read path used by RaceChrono-like tools.

tests.title: UOID Mode 04: clear DTC (end of campaign only)
tests.do: After the 11.1.2 snapshot is saved: clear DTCs and re-read to verify the clear.
tests.warn: Only after all other tests are done — DTCs are also evidence of swap anomalies.

stages.title: PCM-off method (diff vs. baseline)
stages.warn: Disconnecting the stock PCM of the MX-5 ND — only with the ignition off and the battery terminal unclamped. After the test — restore the connection.
checklist: Goal: determine which CAN IDs the stock PCM of the MX-5 ND generates, which a gateway/RX-8 ECU cannot provide.
1) Physically disconnect the stock PCM (unplug its connector).
2) Turn the ignition on (the engine will not start).
3) Record the CAN traffic (test 12.1.1).
4) Compare with the stage 1.1.2 (ign_on) and 1.1.3 (idle) logs. The IDs absent with the PCM disconnected are the PCM messages — the gateway must emulate them.
Critical for emulation: 0x202 (RPM/speed/accelerator), 0x78 (brake), EPS (critical), immobilizer (critical).

tests.title: Recording: PCM off, ignition on
tests.do: PCM unplugged, ignition on, engine not started

stages.title: Stress-test method (module disconnects)
stages.warn: Only on stand; battery disconnected while a module is pulled (see checklist).
checklist: Goal: find the PCM's 'service' messages that change when errors occur.
1) Connect to the bus and start recording.
2) Temporarily disconnect one of the modules (e.g. DSC or the ABS wheel sensor).
3) Record the traffic (test 13.1.1).
4) Compare with the reference log (stage 1): messages that appear/change on disconnection are diagnostic or service messages: block them, or pass them through in a compatible format.

stages.title: Verification and documentation
checklist: Repeat all tests 3 times (reproducibility).
Compare with the existing DBCs: RaceChrono MX-5 ND DBC and the ND swap project data.
Document the anomalies: messages that appear irregularly and do not correlate with the actions.
Create the final ND DBC: a 'CAN ID -> byte -> bit -> physical quantity -> formula' table, stating the state in which each signal is active.

Close the open list: (a) handbrake/DSC EPS state IDs, (b) immobilizer handshake frames, (c) PCM message set (stage 12 diff), (d) UOID gateway paths (stage 11), (e) which body signals are MS-only and need a separate MS-CAN scenario.
